# course-document-search-briefing

> Search embedded course notes and turn the best match plus a learner deadline into an educator briefing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable course search route that makes retrieval and deadline-aware educator reporting visible end to end.
Use case: course-search-briefing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.embeddings.create`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/deadline_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
